name: Al. Canter
role: Foreman of the Bad Lands Cattle Co.
bio: Al. Canter was foreman of the Bad Lands Cattle Co. In June 1885 he advertised a $10 reward for a rawhide lariat lost near the mouth of Box Elder.

moments.label: Offered $10 for a lost rawhide lariat

mentions: Al. Canter says he don't mind so much the going up, but it is the coming down that hurts. We did n't suppose there was anything with hair on that could lay Al. in the sand, but he…
Al. Canter foreman of the Bad Lands Cattle Co., lost a rawhide lariat near mouth of Box Elder, it was on a VI horse, he will pay $10 on its return to this office by the finder.
